external_decisions.decision_question: Confirm, reject, or retain as unverified WO-P-C-LINK-001, WO-C-SHORTAGE-001, and COMPAT-M320-001 before any Migration 320 business approval or execution.

exact 92-file bootstrap candidate and A7 review-baseline-before SHA256 inventory
Remediation 7 on-disk artifacts and independent governance fixture, production, mutation, boundary, and Migration 320 reruns

review_scope_details.boundary: This review assesses only the bootstrap Rule governance mechanism. The separate Migration 320 human decision does not change the mechanism outcome and this review grants no railway business authority.

methods_and_commands.command: Read-only SHA256 and byte-size comparison for every review-baseline-before candidate, frozen_history, remediation_7, migration_320_task, and migration_320_external entry
methods_and_commands.observed: 92/92 candidate, 340/340 frozen history, 40/40 R7, 13/13 M320 Task, and 5/5 external evidence entries matched. The governance manifest SHA256 matched 8A76C7A6FCC8B6184AE3E0DBBB23DB6478E00EB34DD3B6A04B9F15ACB152BF51 before and after the independent reruns.

methods_and_commands.command: Read-only inspection of Rule and Railway Domain review schemas, fixed meta/Domain registries, proposed-domain-rules.mjs, rule-class.mjs, domain-review-routing.mjs, gate-router.mjs, and validate-task.mjs
methods_and_commands.observed: The production call chain enforces explicit Rule class/effect pairs, unique resolution, namespace-independent business-category checks, proposed-only Domain records, typed mechanism-versus-external routing, and separate Candidate Review and Migration 320 gate reasons. However, the dedicated railway-domain-review.schema.json contract is malformed JSON and is not loaded by validate-task.mjs.

methods_and_commands.command: node JSON.parse of .codex/blueprints/schemas/railway-domain-review.schema.json followed by reference search across production and test entrypoints
methods_and_commands.observed: JSON.parse failed at the end of the document because line 8 closes the outcome and properties objects but not the governance_mechanism_outcome object. The only references are manifest/baseline evidence; validate-task.mjs loads review-findings.schema.json instead, and the green Domain production cases exercise only that duplicated inline schema.

68/68 passed. Cases 57-63 covered proposed-only Domain registry, confirmed Domain rejection, candidate/applicable separation, generic meta business rejection, unsupported railway authority, allowed governance/technical controls, and duplicate identity rejection.

27/27 passed. PROD-DOMAIN-01 proved mechanism PASS can coexist with Migration 320 NEEDS_HUMAN_DECISION; PROD-DOMAIN-02 through PROD-DOMAIN-05 proved mechanism blocking, illegal external-to-candidate routing, candidate/applicable rejection, and generic meta business bypass rejection.
17/17 mutations were killed and none survived. MUT-07, MUT-16, and MUT-17 specifically exercised external-as-mechanism, generic-meta-business, and railway-candidate-applicable faults.

methods_and_commands.command: Read-only in-memory Node probe importing the exact production Rule modules and current Domain registry
methods_and_commands.observed: The current registry had zero violations. Agent-filled human_owner, confirmed Domain status, railway_domain_authority, generic meta business classification, and candidate-to-applicable selection were each rejected. The first PowerShell node -e form failed before imports because nested quotes were stripped; the corrected equivalent command exited 0 and no source file was written.

VALIDATE_TASK_RESULT reported structural=VALID, target migration_320_execution:NO-GO, and exit=2. The three proposed candidate Rules lacked human business authority, the Domain decision remained NEEDS_HUMAN_DECISION, and the original Migration 320 blockers remained. No --write-graph flag was used.

independent_formal_review.reason: The assigned run/session identity is unique, does not match the R7 implementer session, and no implementation conversation was used.

explicit_rule_class_and_effect_required.reason: rule_class and authority_effect are schema-required and the production classifier rejects missing, unsupported, or mismatched pairs.

generic_meta_business_bypass_rejected.reason: domain/compatibility categories cannot use generic governance or technical classes, and meta registries cannot carry railway business classes. Production and mutation tests detect this exploit family independently.

candidate_applicable_separation.reason: Only confirmed governance_control and technical_constraint records can resolve as bootstrap applicable Rules. Proposed Domain candidates resolve only through candidate_rules and are rejected from applicable_rules.

unsupported_railway_authority_rejected.reason: railway_domain_authority maps only to unsupported and is always rejected in bootstrap mode.

self_escalation_and_status_promotion_rej.reason: The proposed Domain validator rejects owner/approved_at authority and truthy human_owner, approval, or authority fields. It also restricts Domain status to proposed/candidate/unverified, so confirmed cannot self-promote.

typed_mechanism_external_decision_routin.reason: The production router and the duplicate inline schema in review-findings.schema.json correctly separate mechanism and Migration 320 outcomes. The dedicated railway-domain-review.schema.json is nevertheless malformed and unreferenced by production validation, so the candidate's advertised typed Domain contract cannot be parsed and can drift without any test failing.

fixed_loader_and_unique_resolution.reason: Production loads only fixed meta registries and the proposed Domain registry; every selected Rule ID must resolve exactly once, preventing first-match authority and indirect report promotion.

confirmed_rule_count_zero.reason: The bootstrap contract intentionally supports no confirmed railway business authority. Zero confirmed Rules is a fail-closed boundary and is not a mechanism defect.

no_actual_railway_rule_approved.reason: This formal review accepts only the governance mechanism and grants no maintenance, inventory, permission, compatibility, audit, or Migration 320 authority.

A5-DOMAIN-META-REGISTRY-BYPASS-001.reason: The current production classifier rejects business categories under generic meta classes, the fixed registry/unique resolver prevents namespace and first-match bypass, PROD-DOMAIN-05 passes, and MUT-16 is killed.

A6-DOMAIN-HUMAN-DECISION-001.reason: The human business decision remains open and fail-closed, but the typed router now prevents it from overwriting or blocking the independent mechanism outcome.

findings.title: Dedicated Railway Domain review schema is malformed and outside production schema coverage
findings.reproducible_read_only_check: Run node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('.codex/blueprints/schemas/railway-domain-review.schema.json','utf8'))" from the product root; observe SyntaxError. Then search for railway-domain-review.schema and observe no production or test loader reference.
findings.observed: The governance_mechanism_outcome property is missing its outer closing brace. JSON.parse fails, while fixtures 68/68, production 27/27, and mutations 17/17 remain green because validate-task.mjs validates the duplicated inline fields in review-findings.schema.json and never parses the dedicated schema.
findings.impact: A candidate artifact presented as the typed Railway Domain contract is unusable by a consumer, and its divergence or corruption is not fail-closed. The mechanism cannot receive formal PASS while this machine-readable contract and its coverage are defective.
required_remediation: Repair the malformed JSON and prove that every candidate .schema.json file is parsed by an authoritative test or validator.
Use one authoritative Railway Domain review schema in production validation, or mechanically derive the inline review-findings definition from the dedicated schema so the two contracts cannot drift.
Add production and mutation coverage showing malformed or divergent Railway Domain schema input fails closed, then obtain a fresh independent Domain review on a new immutable candidate baseline.

external_decision_record.disposition: Preserve NEEDS_HUMAN_DECISION and Migration 320 NO-GO until the human Domain owner decides each proposed Rule and the separate Migration 320 blockers are resolved.

limitations: Workspace-produced bootstrap evidence establishes internal consistency only; it does not create trusted producer, Git, commit, release, or railway business authority.
No Git state, service, product code, product test, database, seed, migration source, or migration execution was inspected or run.
The five Migration 320 external evidence files were checked only against the approved hashes; their business meaning was not reinterpreted.
No actual railway Rule was approved. Any future candidate manifest, typed Rule, approval workflow, or routing change requires a new review.
reviewer_command_notes: One initial Node boundary-probe command failed before module import because PowerShell stripped nested quotes; the equivalent corrected read-only command passed and is the only probe result relied on.

One read-only rg command named a nonexistent optional implementation-plan.yaml path; the existing A7 task intent, blueprint, approval, assignments, independence, baseline, R7 evidence, and production source files were independently read.

One read-only rg command first looked for schema-validator.mjs in a governance subdirectory; the subsequent source search located the actual .codex/scripts/lib/schema-validator.mjs path. This path correction did not affect the dedicated-schema parse finding.

conclusion.routing_statement: The Migration 320 external decision affects only migration_320_execution and does not cause or replace the independent mechanism BLOCKER.
